description: Check an async doseedo task once. Returns current status, and the result (file URLs / notes) when finished.

job_id.description: Alternatively the job_id (job_…) from a submit tool or the jobs API — replaces task_id + kind.

kind.description: Which job kind created the task — the registry name the submit reply carried (generate_music, generate_sound, cover_stem, fill_gap, render_midi, train_instrument, render_score, session_from_stems, cover_song, separate_stems, transcribe, audio_to_session, convert_project, bounce_session, analyze_song, detect_chords, beat_grid, check_take, analyze_midi); the short codes (generate, sound, coverstem, fillgap, render, train, score, stemsess, cover, separate, session, convert, bounce, analyze, chords, beats, check, harmony) are accepted aliases.

task_id.description: The task_id returned by a submit tool.

name: doseedo_check_task
title: Check a job
